notes.title: Small steam update
notes.notes:
Hello Planimal trainers, as our promise to keep you all updated, we've just launched a small update with various fixes. In addition to this, the demo on our steam page has been updated to reflect the fixes from QOL 1 & 2.

Switch has also been brought up to parity, with the PC version which you can read about here.

notes.title: Quality of Life Update 2: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey everyone.

Next week, we'll be updating Monster Harvest with some new features and additions, as well as an extensive list of bug fixes which you can find below. With QOL2 releasing on PC, our full attention is now on the console versions - fixing existing issues and bringing the consoles up to parity with the PC updates. These ports will take some time - while we understand the frustration, we do appreciate your patience. When we have new info regarding the ports, we'll update the community with that news.

notes.title: Holiday Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

First off, as we have said numerous times now, thank you for the feedback that’s been shared since the beta through to launch and beyond, it shapes the way we develop and build the game.

After the post-launch flurry of updates, things have been a little quieter, which isn’t ideal. We really want to provide you with meaningful updates which we couldn't do until the initial bug fixing patches were completed and work progressed on the more quality of life focused update which was promised.

We’re a small team but we’re passionate about what we do and giving you an enjoyable gaming experience is really what we sign up for by coming to work in the games industry. We know there have been frustrations out there and despite things being quieter on the communication front, we’ve certainly tried to give every player a voice, hear your concerns and take them to heart. We don’t want to overpromise on something until we’re sure of it, so a lot of Monster Harvest has been behind the scenes work lately.

With that said, we’re in a position now to share details on the next updates for Monster Harvest! These will come in the form of 2 updates, for all platforms.

Update 1
Coming early in the new year! It will land on PC first, followed by consoles which require some additional porting and certification before we can get them out to you.

Massive UI overhaul

 Menus all optimized and some redesigned
  Text popups for pickups and items
  Rescaled multiple text instance

- Controller support improvements

 Improving controls & menu navigation when using a controller

- Crop signposting

 Crops will now more clearly tell you when they are ready to harvest

- A map of Planimal Point is now available

- See where you stand with the resident of Planimal Point with a new relationship tracker

- Clearer stamina and exp usage and caps

- General game & economy balancing 

- Lots of minor bug fixes 

Then there will be another update a little further along the new year which will bring big changes to the Planimal System, customisation & in-game story!
We’ll share more details on that soon, but we wanted to give you an overview of what is being worked on.

Thank you for playing Monster Harvest and stay tuned for more in the new year, happy holidays from us all at Merge Games & Maple Powered Games!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363350/Monster_Harvest/

notes.title: Hotfix #8

We've been hard at work on the latest hotfix and we're pleased to share that hotfix #8 is now live!

 Fixed issue with mount blocker.
 Fixed an issue where players sometimes could not interact with the pause menu using mouse & keyboard.
 Fixed an issue where slimes sometimes were not able to be sold or trashed.
 Feed hopper will now refill correctly when upgrading the barn interior.

notes.title: Hotfix #5
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We're still investigating the issue with crops not growing, and the feedback from some players post hotfix 4 has been really helpful. Game data is really valuable in solving this so if anyone is able to send their data through to us it can help narrow the problem down.

These are the steps to take to share your game data:

 Open any windows explorer window and paste the following into the search bar %appdata%/../LocalLow/Maple Powered Games
 You will see a folder called Monster harvest
 Right-click and select ‘zip’ or utilise whatever zipping tool you use.
 Email the zipped folder to us at techsupport@mergegames.com - Please put in the email title - ‘Monster Harvest Game Data’


Here are the updates in Hotfix 5:

 Pressing Esc during battle no longer creates a softlock.
 Application of green slime to crops fixed.	
 XP gauge now says "MAX" when the player reaches the max xp Level.	
 Some Ultra wide resolutions are now supported: 3840x1080, 3840x1200, 3840x1600, 5120x2160.	
 Debug Menu was accidentally enabled and is now disabled.


Thank you, everyone!

notes.title: Hotfix #4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Sorry for the slower updates this week, a few things took a bit longer in testing but we are happy to share Hotfix 4 and have addressed a few of the bigger bugs that are outstanding.

Hotfix #4 updates

 Fixed an issue with Planimals disappearing 
 The bunker should now function correctly
 Fixed an issue with crops not growing in the dark season
 Fixed a bug where a floor tile can appear on your head when entering the bunker.


Per our last update, we're continuing to work on fixing key bugs and addressing balancing and quality of life issues raised by players.

It's been a rocky start, but we're hopeful that the experience is much improved with these patches and we look forward to talking with you all about more fun content updates and the future of Monster Harvest.

 Stables are not getting built

There are a number of items under testing that we'll be aiming to roll out as soon as possible, including some much-requested quality of life features.

Thanks for the patience and support and we'll continue to update as often as possible.

notes.title: Demo - Update 1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've loved seeing so many people roll up their sleeves and get to farming in the Monster Harvest demo.

There's been some wonderful feedback and we wanted to thank everyone for letting us know how they've been getting on in Planimal Point.

There's a lot of small bug fixes behind the scenes but here are some key fixes

 "Out of bounds" errors fixed throughout the game.
 Issues with disappearing tools in chests should be fixed
 Issues where crops decide to walk off in the night should be solved - it seems the professor might have been spreading slime where he shouldn't!
 Some character sprites and portraits adjusted to more accurately reflect the intended design
 Various balance changes to more accurately reflect the intended full game experience.

All of your feedback is very helpful and very welcome so please do continue to share and we look forward to opening up the full game for you very soon!

notes.title: Release date moved to August 19th
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We never like to deliver news of a delay, but we want to let you know that the release date of Monster Harvest has been moved to August 19th.

Here are some words from Maple Powered Games join owner Kerry Vandenberg.

“Delays are awful, we are sorry to let down our friends and fans, yet we want to make sure we dispatch Monster Harvest in the best shape possible so that our whole community will enjoy it. We realized how important it is to ensure high-quality support for as many regions as possible right from launch day, even if that means having to push back our release date by just over a month. We are shipping the game by August 19th, with no further days and it’ll be worth it when we show what we have in store for you.”

There's always an upside though, and in this case we've extended this date to ensure that further slippage is totally off the table. We're very confident with the game that we will deliver on August 19th and we're delighted that even more players around the world will be able to share the experience on launch.

Wishlist Monster Harvest.

Join us on Discord.
